    counts = {}
    for n in records:
        counts[n["tag"]] = counts.get(n["tag"], 0) + 1
    return counts

WHY = {
    'send SMS reminders': 'reduce no-shows',
    'open a waitlist': 'reduce no-shows',
    'reduce no-shows': 'keep every slot full',
}

def ladder_up(feature):
    chain = [feature]
    while chain[-1] in WHY:
        chain.append(WHY[chain[-1]])
    return ' -> '.join(chain)

print(ladder_up('send SMS reminders'))
print(ladder_up('open a waitlist'))
